readout_other: Local field potential in tail motor cortex and tail EMG; mutual information and transfer entropy coupling
direction_notes: Cortico-muscular coupling (mutual information and transfer entropy) increased after pTUS, and increased further with the number of tone bursts (NTB 100 to 300).

exposures.label: pTUS to tail motor cortex, NTB 100-300

timing.protocol_description: Pulsed TUS with 250 acoustic cycles per pulse (NC), PRF 1 kHz, inter-trial interval 3.6 s; the sonication duration was changed with the number of tone bursts (NTB 100, 150, 200, 250, 300). Pulse duration, duty cycle and sonication duration in time units are not stated.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Nine BALB/c mice (male, body weights \~ 20  g, Beijing Vital River Laboratory Animal Technology Co., Ltd.
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: The experimental system is shown in Fig.  1a, consisting of six main components: (1) two function generators (AFG3022C, Tektronix, USA), (2) a linear radio frequency power amplifier (RFA) (240L, ENI Inc., USA), (3) an unfocused ultrasound transducer (V301-SU, Olympus, Japan) with center frequency of 500  kHz and diameter of 31  mm driven by RFA, and (4) an custom conical plastic collimator (Length 50 mm, diameter 2 and 31.2 mm) filled with degassed ultrasound gel and delivering the pTUS to the cortex, (5) single-channel microelectrodes (WE50030.1B10, MicroProbe, USA) recording the LFPs and fine wire electrode recording EMG signals,(6) a dual-channel front-end amplifier (63386, A-M SYSTEMS INC., USA) that amplifying the LFPs and EMG signals, and a 16-channel neural signal processor (NSP) (Cerebus Data Acquisition System, Blackrock Microsystems, USA) converting the signals into digital signals, (7) a computer for data storage and displaying the recorded data simultaneously.
source_quotes.exposures[0].unspecified_domain.isppa_w_: In this paper, the parameter setting is AI 1.10 W/cm<sup>2</sup>, NC 250, PRF 1 kHz, ITI 3.6 s.

flags.reason: Paper gives 'acoustic intensity (AI)' 1.10 W/cm2 without saying whether spatial-peak pulse-average or temporal-average, or measured where; placed in isppa as the nearest field.
Only 250 cycles per pulse at 500 kHz is stated; no pulse duration in time units given.
Sonication duration varies with NTB (100-300 tone bursts) but is not stated in seconds.
Mice were anaesthetised for surgery and recorded after the anaesthesia effect was over; recorded as awake.
'Number of tone bursts' (NTB) appears to count pulses; meaning of 'tone burst' not fully resolved.
